Package httyd.battle

Class TypeChart

java.lang.Object
httyd.battle.TypeChart
public final class TypeChart extends Object
The elemental advantage table. Every class beats two classes, loses to two classes and is neutral against the rest, so there is no strongest class. An elemental move that hits a weakness deals 25% more damage; one that hits a resistance deals 20% less. 
 Strike > Boulder, Tidal      Tracker > Boulder, Strike
 Boulder > Sharp, Mystery     Tidal > Stoker, Tracker
 Sharp > Stoker, Strike       Mystery > Sharp, Tidal
 Stoker > Tracker, Mystery
